==Biography==

Hứa '''"EasyLove"''' Thành An started his career as bot laner on the newly promoted [[LG Red]] in the [[VCS A/2017 Season/Summer Season |VCS 2017 Summer Season]].

===2018 Season===

After being relegated with LG Red, '''Easylove''' would join [[GAM Esports]] as trainee. It would be not long as he would join [[Hall of Fame]] in the middle of the split. The Hall of Fame squad would end up finishing last place with a 1-13 record. Easylove and his team would bounce back and not relegate, winning the [[VCS/2018 Season/Summer Promotion |VCS Summer Promotion]] round. 

In the [[VCS/2018 Season/Summer Season |VCS Summer Season]], '''Easylove''' would be the pinnacle of success. He would start all of the games at [[Cube Adonis]] and finish 3rd in the regular split with a 9-5 record. They would reach the finals in the [[VCS/2018 Season/Summer Playoffs |VCS Summer Playoffs]] and lose against [[Phong Vũ Buffalo]] 1-3, missing out on the [[2018 Season World Championship]].

===2019 Season===

'''Easylove''' would remain on [[CERBERUS Esports (Vietnamese Team)|CERBERUS Esports]] (which rebranded from Cube Adonis), finishing 6th place in [[VCS/2019 Season/Spring Season|Spring]] (5-9) and 8th place in [[VCS/2019 Season/Summer Season|Summer]] (3-11). He would end up getting released from CERBERUS Esports after the Summer split had ended.

===2020 Season===

After being released from CERBERUS Esports, '''Easylove''' would return to [[GAM Esports]] as substitute bot laner behind [[Blazes]] and [[Hieu3]].

Blazes and Hieu3 would end up released before the [[VCS/2020 Season/Summer Season]] started, which meant that Easylove would start for GAM Esports. Mainly playing utility champions such as {{ci|Ashe}} and {{ci|Jhin}}, the team found a lot of success with '''Easylove'''. The team with Easylove would end up finishing first place in the regular season and losing the [[VCS/2020 Season/Summer Playoffs |VCS Summer Finals]] 2-3 against [[Team Flash.Vietnam|Team Flash]].

Despite having qualified for [[2020 Season World Championship]], Easylove could not attend with his team due to COVID-19 regulations as Vietnamese teams were not allowed to travel. 

===2021 Season===

'''Easylove''' would remain on [[GAM Esports]], alongside [[Style (Mai Hoàng Sơn)|Style]] to battle for a place in the bot lane position for the [[VCS/2021 Season/Spring Season|Spring Season]].

== Trivia ==
* Known as "The people's ADC" by many Vietnamese fans.
